library.emptyDesc: The first one shows up here once you’ve recorded.
library.noHitsDesc: The search looks at the date, the file name and the note.
library.trashLede: Recordings here are deleted for good after {n} days.
library.trashEmptyDesc: Recordings you delete land here first.

record.noSource: You haven't chosen where the sound comes from
record.noSourceDesc: Choose the mixer — or the computer's own microphone if that's what you use.
record.sub: Press Start when the service begins.
record.whyBlocked: Start is blocked until sound is chosen. We never record from a source nobody picked.
record.canStart: You can start anyway — the recording stays silent until the mixer is back.

camera.noneFound: No cameras found — check the connection
camera.listFailed: Could not get the camera list — check permissions
camera.pickFirst: Choose a camera to see the picture
camera.denied: Camera access denied — check System Settings
camera.noResponse: Camera not responding — is another app using it?

setup.q5: Who gets told if something goes wrong?

sound.lede: Choose what you record from, and check that we hear it.
sound.goneDesc: Check that it is on and the cable is in.
sound.noneDesc: We never record from a source nobody chose.
sound.builtInDesc: For testing only, or if you have no mixer.
sound.channelHint: The ones with sound right now light up.
sound.testHint: Speak into the microphone or play something.
sound.emptyDesc: Not even the computer’s own microphone. Check access under System Settings → Privacy.

folder.lede: Recordings are placed in this folder on the computer.
folder.label: Saved to
folder.unknownSpace: We don’t know how much space is left here.
folder.noneDesc: Choose a folder on this computer. Without it the app can’t record.

setup.qualityLede: Higher quality means bigger files. Most people stay on Good.

qDesc.mp3: MP3. Good for the web and sharing. About 1 GB per 10 hours.
qDesc.flac: FLAC. Everything that came in, lossless. About 5 GB per 10 hours.
qDesc.wav: WAV. Uncompressed, the way an archive should be. About 10 GB per 10 hours.

setup.qualityCustomDesc: This combination isn’t one of the three. Pick a card to change it.

church.lede: The name and the language the app uses.
church.name: Congregation or church

notify.lede: The computer always tells you. Email is for whoever isn’t sitting at it.
notify.osDesc: When recording starts, stops or fails.
notify.mailDesc: One address. Sent only on failure, never otherwise.
notify.nobodyDesc: Nobody gets an email — the computer only tells whoever is sitting at it.
notify.emailDesc: Sent only on failure, never otherwise.
notify.gateSmtp: Requires a mail server (SMTP). Set it up under Advanced.
notify.gateNoFeature: Email sending is not built into this version.
notify.toDesc: The address the alert goes to.
notify.invalid: Enter a valid email address, for example name@church.org
notify.testFailed: The test email did not go through: {err}
notify.testNoRecipient: Enter an address and press Save first.
notify.remindDesc: So someone has time to turn on the mixer.

camera.title: Include camera
camera.keepAudioDesc: A plain audio file next to the video.
camera.delivers: The camera delivers at most {height}p · {fps} frames per second.
camera.probeFailed: We could not read what the camera can do. The recording uses what the camera actually delivers, up to 1080p.
camera.noneDesc: Connect a camera, or turn off “Include camera”.

auto.title: Record automatically
auto.desc: Set a time once. The computer wakes and starts on its own.
auto.durationDesc: The recording stops by itself after this.
auto.launchDesc: Without this the recording won’t start after a restart.
auto.more: This computer has {n} weekly times. Here you change the first one.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.lede: Things most people never need to touch. Everything here has a safe default.
advanced.engineDesc: Only switch if the sound stutters.
advanced.prerollDesc: Sound kept from before you pressed Start. The buffer holds the microphone open in the background for as long as the app is ready to record.
advanced.silenceDesc: Stops the recording once it has been completely silent for a while.
advanced.maxLenDesc: A safety net if someone forgets to stop.
advanced.splitDesc: Starts a new file at a set interval, so no single file gets enormous.
advanced.autoDeleteDesc: Moved to the trash, not deleted for good.
advanced.diagDesc: Never audio, names or files. You can see exactly what is sent.
advanced.diagPreviewNext: This is exactly what will be sent next time.
advanced.diagPreviewHistory: Diagnostics are off. This shows the shape of the data from your own local history — nothing is sent.
advanced.diagDeleteBody: Your anonymous ID is replaced with a new one, and reports not yet sent are cleared. SundayRec then asks the server to delete everything held under the old ID.
advanced.diagDeleteConfirm: Yes, clear and swap the ID
advanced.diagDeleted: The data is cleared locally, and you have a new anonymous ID.
advanced.diagDeleteFailed: Could not delete the data. Try again.
advanced.updateDesc: Stable is recommended. Beta gets new things first.
advanced.autoUpdateDesc: Checks every hour whether a newer version exists. Nothing is downloaded until you say yes.
advanced.updateBetaBody: Beta reaches you before it has been through a real service, and can contain faults that ruin a recording. Do not use beta on the machine that records the service. You can switch back at any time.
advanced.updateReady: Version {v} is downloaded — restart to start using it
advanced.updateRestartFailed: The restart did not happen. Quit the app and open it again, and the update is active.
advanced.logDesc: For troubleshooting together with us. No audio and no passwords.
advanced.logShowFailed: Could not open the log folder.
advanced.profileDesc: Take the setup to another computer. Passwords are never included.
advanced.importBody: This replaces the settings on this computer with the contents of the file. Recordings, the library and passwords are untouched.
advanced.smtpDesc: Failure alerts are sent through the congregation's own e-mail server. Without one, no e-mail arrives.
advanced.smtpFromDesc: Leave it empty to use the user name.
advanced.smtpPasswordDesc: Stored in the computer's keychain, never in the settings.
advanced.smtpInvalidFrom: Enter a valid e-mail address, for example name@church.org
advanced.schedDesc: The weekly time is set on the Record page, in the “Record automatically” card. Here you add more.
advanced.schedFirstIsSetup: The first time is the one you see in the “Record automatically” card on the Record page.
advanced.specialsDesc: A single date — a concert, a Christmas Eve.
advanced.specialPast: That date has passed — a recording will not start.
advanced.wakeDesc: Without this the machine has to be awake when the recording starts.
advanced.autoDeleteConfirmBody: Recordings older than this are moved to the trash. Under 30 days can mean a service is gone before anyone has downloaded it.

wakeWord.can: This machine can be woken from sleep.
wakeWord.cannot: This machine cannot be woken from sleep — leave it switched on.
wakeWord.needsAdmin: This machine can be woken, but asks for an administrator password the first time.
wakeWord.unknown: We do not know yet whether this machine can be woken.

wakeArmWord.idle: Register the wake-up with the operating system now. May ask for an administrator password.
wakeArmWord.ok: The wake-up is registered with the operating system.
wakeArmWord.autoRecordOff: No wake-ups to register — «Record automatically» is off.
wakeArmWord.nothingUpcoming: No wake-ups to register — nothing is scheduled ahead.
wakeArmWord.needsAdmin: Needs an administrator password — try again and answer the prompt.
wakeArmWord.disabled: Turn on «Wake the machine from sleep» first.
wakeArmWord.unsupported: This machine cannot be woken by the app.

diagnose.title: Diagnose
diagnose.desc: Checks sound, permissions, engine and disk, and writes a report you can pass on.
diagnose.probeSkipped: The sound test did not run: {why}
diagnose.devicesTitle: Every audio device the recorder can see
diagnose.ipcTitle: Commands that did not answer this session ({n})
diagnose.testBlocked: Not while a recording is running.

auth.unknown: Cannot be determined on this platform

testErr.deviceNotFound: the audio device was not found

ffmpeg01.title: The recording engine (ffmpeg) is missing
ffmpeg01.hint: Reinstall SundayRec — the recording engine ships with the app.

audio01.title: No audio device found
audio01.hint: Check that the sound card is connected and its driver installed. On a shared PC: is the audio service running?

audio02.title: The chosen audio device was not found
audio02.hint: Connect the device, or pick another one under «Which sound?» on Record.

audio10.title: Fell back to the classic audio engine
audio10.hint: Recording still works. If you want the modern engine, check the driver and that no other program is holding the device.

rate01.title: A fixed sample rate is selected
rate01.hint: If the sound card runs a different rate, ffmpeg resamples and you can get stutter. Choose «Auto» again unless you have a concrete reason.

video01.title: Video is on, but no camera was found
video01.hint: Connect the camera, or turn off «Include camera» on Record.

video02.title: The camera gave no picture
video02.hint: Check that the camera is connected and not in use by another program, and that the app has camera access.

disk01.title: Little free space
disk01.hint: Free up space or choose another save folder before a long recording.

disk02.title: Cannot write to the save folder
disk02.hint: Choose a folder you can write to under «Where is the recording saved?» on Record.

perm01.title: Microphone access is denied
perm01.hint: Grant access in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone, and restart the app.

perm02.title: Camera access is denied
perm02.hint: Grant access in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Camera, and restart the app.

engine01.title: The last recording ended with an error
engine01.hint: The error code is on the line above. Run a test recording to see whether it works now.

capture01.title: The last recording showed signs of stutter
capture01.hint: Close other heavy programs, check the cable and power to the sound card, and that the sample rate is on «Auto». Then record again and see whether the numbers drop.

capture02.title: The sound test got no sound
capture02.hint: Check that the right device is chosen under «Which sound?» on Record, that the cable is in, and that no other program is holding the microphone. Then run the diagnosis again.

crash01.title: The app has crashed
crash01.hint: Pass this report on — the crash files are what make the fault findable.

task01.title: Background tasks had to be restarted
task01.hint: The app restarted them itself, so nothing stopped. If it repeats, bring this report — the names above say which part is unstable.

log01.title: The log file is not active
log01.hint: That usually means the app folder could not be created. Restart the app; if it persists, check disk space and permissions.

log02.title: Part of the log is missing
log02.hint: The log is incomplete because the recording was prioritised — that is the right way round. A slow disk is worth looking at before the next long recording.

recLoss.title: The last recording is missing audio
recLoss.hint: This is serious: the recording lost audio along the way. Close other heavy programs, connect the sound card directly (not through a hub), and report it with this report — the numbers here are the evidence.

first.gateReason: We hear no sound yet. Speak into the microphone, or turn on the mixer.
first.readyDesc: This is the same you will find under Settings (the gear) and on the Record screen later.
first.notifyTodo: Not set up — nobody is told if a recording fails.

consent.title: Want to help make SundayRec better?
consent.desc: Anonymous numbers about what works and what fails. Never audio, names or files.

overlay.stopQuestionDesc: {elapsed} recorded so far. If you stop now, what you have is saved.
overlay.reconnect: Sound from {name} disappeared — trying to reconnect
overlay.reconnectAnon: The sound disappeared — trying to reconnect
overlay.finalizingHint: The recording is being written to disk. It takes a few seconds, and the file is safe meanwhile.

done.title: Recording saved
done.revealFailed: Couldn’t find the file on disk.

editor.loadFailedDesc: The format may not be supported, or the file is damaged.
editor.found: We think the sermon is here
editor.foundDesc: From {from} to {to} — {span}. Drag the handles to adjust.
editor.notSermonDesc: Pick the right block. We remember it next time.
editor.autoSoundDesc: Evens out the level and makes speech clearer. The original is untouched.

profileDesc.none: Export the sound exactly as recorded.

editor.listenAria: Hear the sound before or after the improvement
editor.listenFailed: Could not prepare the sample. The export still runs.
editor.mixerUseDesc: The mixer replaces “{profile}”. No mastering is added on top — you drive the whole chain.

fmtDesc.mp3: Small file. Good for the web and sharing.
fmtDesc.flac: Same quality as the recording, smaller file.

editor.includeVideoDesc: The recording has a video track. Without this the export is audio only.
editor.videoLocksFormat: The format is MP4 while the video is included.

export.emptyDesc: Record something first, or open a file from this machine.

banner.diskDesc: The recording stops when the disk is full. Free up space before Sunday.
banner.missedDesc: The computer was off. Automatic recording needs it on or asleep.
banner.missedHelp: Leave the computer on, or let it sleep — SundayRec wakes it ten minutes before the recording. If it is switched off completely, nothing can start it. Also check that “Start automatically with the computer” is on in the “Record automatically” card on the Record page, so the app is running again after a restart.

preflightErrors.one: {n} error to fix before the recording
preflightErrors.other: {n} errors to fix before the recording

preflightWarns.one: {n} thing to check before the recording
preflightWarns.other: {n} things to check before the recording

home.readyNoSchedule: Ready — set up a schedule to start recordings automatically
home.wakesNotArmed: The machine must be on or asleep when the recording starts — no wake-up has been confirmed.

trash.title: Trash
trash.undoFailed: Could not bring everything back — check the trash.
trash.confirmEmptyBody: The files are deleted from disk. This cannot be undone.

error.tryAgainHint: If the problem persists, run Check system in the Audio settings or restart the app.
error.ipcFailed: Something in the background did not respond, so this view may be incomplete.
error.settingsLoadFailed: Could not read the settings — showing defaults. Changes you make now may be lost.
error.settingsMigrationCorrupt: The settings from the previous version could not be read — the app starts with defaults.

editor.title: Edit audio file
editor.emptyDesc: Pick an audio or video file to start editing. You can trim the start and end, or cut sections out of the middle.
editor.dragHint: Click and drag to mark a cut
editor.normalizeHint: Adjusts the peak to -1 dBFS for a safe final mix.
editor.normalizeResult: Peak now at -1 dBFS — safe for export.
editor.normalizeAlready: The peak is already at -1 dBFS — no change needed.
editor.normalizeExportHint: Normalisation is heard on export, not while previewing.
editor.dropFile: Drop an audio or video file here
editor.emptyTitleDrop: Drop a file here — or click to open
editor.layersNotAnalyzed: Run «Analyse recording» under Clip tools to see speech, music and silence here.
editor.markSermonHint: Trims everything before and after the highlighted sermon block.
editor.ioDragHint: — or drag a file onto the timeline
editor.jinglesVideoUnsupported: Jingles are not supported for video yet
editor.confirmClose: You have unsaved changes. Close anyway?
editor.confirmOpenOther: You have unsaved changes. Open a new file anyway?
editor.errNoAudioRemaining: No audio left — the cuts cover the entire recording. Remove at least one cut before exporting.
editor.errTimeout: Export took too long and was stopped. Try again, or split the file into smaller recordings.
editor.errFileNotFound: Original file is not available — is the disk disconnected?
editor.errCutData: Internal error in cut data. Try reloading the file.
editor.playbackViaProxy: Playback runs through a temporary intermediate file (full quality). Export always uses the original.
editor.qualityFallback: Playback is not available for this file — the format cannot be played here. Cutting and export work as usual.
editor.autoEnhanceFail: Could not analyze the audio (requires the editor build).
editor.chanDeadLeft: Left channel is silent (check the cable)
editor.chanDeadRight: Right channel is silent (check the cable)
editor.errInvalidFormat: This format is not supported for export. Choose a different format on the Export page.
editor.errPathNotAbsolute: Invalid folder or file path. Choose the destination folder again.

recording.finalizingHint: One moment — the audio is being written to file.
recording.finalizeTimeout: The recording is taking unusually long to finish. Check that the file was saved.
recording.confirmBody: The recording will be saved up to this point.
recording.errorPermission: Microphone access denied — open System Settings and grant access
recording.errorDeviceNotFound: Audio device not found — check the USB connection
recording.errorNotReadable: The audio device is in use by another application
recording.errorDeviceError: Error opening the audio device — try reconnecting it
recording.errorAlreadyRecording: A recording is already in progress
recording.errorEmpty: The recording is empty — no audio reached the app from the device
recording.errorFolderPermission: No access to the save folder — make sure it's writable
recording.errorFolderError: Can't create the save folder — check disk space and permissions
recording.errorDeviceDisconnected: The audio device was disconnected during recording — check the connection
recording.errorDiskFull: The disk is full — free up space and try again
recording.errorFfmpegMissing: Internal error: the recording binary is missing — reinstall the app
recording.errorStuck: Recording stopped — no audio from the device for 60 seconds
recording.qualityAlarm: WARNING: The recording is missing audio — the file holds {m} of {e} seconds. Check the recording before trusting it.
recording.errorInvalidOpts: Invalid recording settings — restart and try again
recording.errorNoSaveFolder: No save folder selected — go to the Record page and pick one in the “Where do recordings go?” card
recording.errorUnknown: Something went wrong during recording — check that the audio device and save folder are ready
recording.silenceWarn: Silence detected — the recording will stop automatically if the silence continues.
recording.autostopFailed: Could not change the auto-stop. The recording continues — stop it manually if you need to.
recording.qrNoAudio: No audio was captured — the file is too small to hold anything.
recording.qrSilent: The recording is silent — no signal. Check the device and the gain.
recording.qrGapFail: Parts of the audio are missing or silent — stuttering or dropouts.
recording.qrDropsFail: Many dropouts from the audio device.
recording.qrSampleRate: The sample rate was forced away from the device's own — the conversion can cause dropouts.
recording.qrGapWarn: A small gap or silence in the recording.
recording.qrLowSignal: Weak signal — consider raising the gain.
recording.qrDropsWarn: A few dropouts from the audio device.

onboarding.promptDesc: SundayRec can send anonymous error and usage statistics to Sunday Suite to improve the app. Optional, and you can answer any time under Settings → Advanced.
onboarding.rePromptDesc: You have answered this before, but we are asking again because what would be shared has been extended: your corrections in the editor can now also say roughly how far an automatic suggestion was moved — for example “30–60 seconds earlier” — and not only that it was moved. The text itself is never sent. Your previous answer has not been assumed, neither as a yes nor as a no, and nothing is sent until you answer here.

dialog.discardEditsBody: The cuts you have made will be lost. The recording file itself is untouched.

guard.title: {what} now?
guard.duringRecording: A recording is running right now. The change can interrupt or ruin what is being recorded.

beforeRecording.one: The next scheduled recording starts in {n} minute. The change will affect that recording.
beforeRecording.other: The next scheduled recording starts in {n} minutes. The change will affect that recording.

health.micDenied: Microphone access is denied. Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone and enable SundayRec.
health.micRestricted: Microphone access is blocked by a system administrator or parental controls. Recording will not work until the block is lifted.
health.cameraDenied: Camera access is denied. Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Camera and enable SundayRec.
health.cameraRestricted: Camera access is blocked by a system administrator or parental controls. Video recording will not work until the block is lifted.
health.ffmpegMissing: The bundled audio engine (ffmpeg) was not found. Video, export and editing will not work — reinstall the app.

notify.prerollDead: The pre-roll buffer is not working — sound from before you press record is not being kept.
notify.recoverySkipped: An interrupted recording could not be fully recovered: {file}
notify.deviceMissing: The audio device “{device}” is not connected.
notify.diskLow: Disk space is running low — {freeGb} GB free. The recording will stop on its own if the disk fills up.
